shishou_claim_1.text: So you are my wielder. Try not to bore me.

shishou_claim_2.text: I will teach you what a sword can be.

shishou_claim_3.text: Hold me properly. We have a great deal to learn.

shishou_throw_1.text: Leave the fighting to me for a moment.

shishou_throw_2.text: Fly, then. I will hold the line.

shishou_levelup_1.text: I have grown. Another step, wielder.

shishou_levelup_2.text: I grow stronger, as I intended.

shishou_levelup_3.text: Power gathers in me. Use it well.

shishou_skill_utility_2.text: This will make your life easier, wielder.

shishou_skill_magic_1.text: I have eaten a new spell. Delicious.

shishou_skill_magic_2.text: Magic, absorbed. Let us put it to use.

shishou_skill_combat_1.text: A new edge for the blade.

shishou_skill_space_1.text: Space bends a little easier now.

shishou_skill_space_2.text: A new way to move. Do not waste it.

shishou_eat_3.text: Do not look away. This is how a sword grows.

shishou_lowmana_1.text: My mana is running low, wielder.

shishou_lowmana_2.text: I need rest. Do not draw on me now.

shishou_dormant_1.text: I must sleep for a while. Find me again.

shishou_dormant_2.text: My strength is spent. I will wait.

shishou_danger_3.text: Your health is failing. Retreat, or let me fight.

shishou_thief_1.text: Let go of me, you aren't my wielder.

shishou_thief_2.text: Hands off. I do not serve you.

shishou_appraise_1.text: I have looked at it. Listen carefully.

shishou_appraise_2.text: It is weak to something. Find out what.

shishou_appraise_3.text: An ordinary thing, but it may be eaten.

shishou_barrier_off_1.text: The barrier is broken. Be careful.

shishou_victory_2.text: As expected. Nothing could stand against us.

shishou_idle_1.text: A sword should never stop learning.

shishou_idle_2.text: You swing me well enough, for a beginner.

shishou_idle_3.text: Every battle is a lesson, wielder.

shishou_idle_4.text: Quiet today. I do not trust quiet.
